sense.text:
“If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God.” Unlike the Christian church, Israel can talk about anything: war, slavery, marriage, health, sports, whatever it is. But whatever is talked about, it goes back to the scriptures. You must use the Bible to back up what you are saying and what you are producing.

The world was made for Israel, so it is only right that Israel has an expertise in the world, and reads all of it through the Bible. That is the opposite of the pastor who took thirty minutes on two scriptures from the same passage and sounded like a dog.

So this recap of the year is a recap through a biblical lens: not the way MTV, CNN or ABC recap the year, but through the eyes of the children of Israel. And for that, it is important to understand who you are.

Before the year can be recapped, perspective must be settled. The Bible is a history book, and every history is seen through the viewpoint of whoever tells it. You can't truly look at the Holocaust if you don't know who the so-called Jews are, and you can't look at slavery if you don't know who the slaves are. So it is a lie when they say it doesn't matter who you are when you read the Bible. If you read it through the lens of a white man with blonde hair and blue eyes, or as a Gentile, or as an African-American or a black man, you are reading it wrong and you will never understand it. When you know who you are and you see a white Jesus, you say, Hold on, that don't line up with the Bible.

“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” We must know who we are when we read the Bible to understand it, and Christ said it. If a man is a middle-aged white man who owns companies and has millions of dollars, what does he need to be free from? That verse has no power to him.

But when you understand who you are, that your people are at the bottom, being shot dead in the streets, persecuted and taken advantage of left and right, the scripture has a different meaning, because of the perspective you are reading it from. Perspective means a lot, and you must understand who you are in these last days.

We need to know who the Bible is written to, who the target audience is. The spirit entered into the prophet, and the Lord said, “Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel”: their fathers “have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.”

“For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God.” The word was sent to Israel, and that is why 1 Peter 4:11 came first: speak as the oracles of God, to the people the oracles were given to.

So who are we? According to the Bible, you so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans are the children of Israel. You're not black, you're not Hispanic, you're not colored. You are the greatest people on the face of the earth, thus saith the Lord.

Identity matters. In The Lion King the father tells his son, Remember who you are: you are the son of a king. That is the same thing Israel is telling our people today: remember who you are and where you come from. This is what they never want you to do, track your true identity and your true history. They start your history on a slave ship and end it with a bullet in Martin Luther King's head, so that you see only slavery and death and settle for being black or African-American, dribbling a basketball and getting along to get along.

“For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age.” Where do you come from? Before you were brought here on the slave ships, what were you called, what did you eat, how were your clothes, what were your customs and traditions, what days did you worship? You don't know, because your master never taught you.

“and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers.” The only people on the face of the earth who don't know who their fathers are, are the so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, because when they got off the slave ships it was beat out of them. You tried to say your name was Kunta Kinte, and they said, No, your name shall be Toby, because a name would identify you with who you come from and your true heritage.

Contrary to popular belief, your heritage does matter, your nationality does matter, your race does matter, according to the Bible. Why else would he tell them to search for their fathers? The world knows it too: genetics is a billion-dollar industry, and people spend billions on ancestry tests. They tap into the fact that we don't know who we are, while the Bible gives you your whole history for free, and the prophets are teaching it for free all over the world.

A well-respected theologian, who preached before white people all over, taught that race is a social construct and not a biblical concept. False. The Bible is the family tree; Genesis 10 is the table of nations, and nations are the beginning of nationhood, race.

“My son, keep the flower of thine age sound”: your seed, your nobility, your race. “and give not thy strength to strangers”: don't pollute your seed with these other nations.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field”: find your wife. “sow it with thine own seed, trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” Your own stock. Seed and race are the same thing.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” The word race is right there in the Bible. These pastors don't know the Bible, and notice that the man never opened the Bible once, yet thirteen thousand people liked it. Time is up on the Christian church.

“And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.” His people is his family, his kinfolk. When you are at somebody's house and they say, That's his people, they mean his family. Kindred and kinfolk are all in the Bible, because the Bible was written by black people.

Christ came to save his own race. He never came for any other race or any other nation. Following these wicked pastors, you will believe otherwise. That is why the old family Bibles had the whole family line written in them: lineage mattered.

The pastor says we are all the race of Adam, one race, one blood. We do all come from Adam, and nobody is saying he is wrong on that. But watch what the Bible says: “of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.” The people God chose came out of Adam too, which means he made a difference among all people. Everybody is not just from the seed of Adam and that's it. If race did not matter, why are the people in the land today, and why does America give them billions under the false pretense that they are the children of Israel?
“because thou madest the world for our sakes.” The world was made for the chosen people.

“As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing.” There is a difference: the chosen people, and then the other people. It is like the shoe brands: Michael Jordan, K-Swiss, Converse, Reebok, Adidas, New Balance. God chose the Israelite and did not choose the other shoes. Those other people are nothing to him; he is not concerned with them.

We must know who we are, and we are the Israelites. “The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know.” The Israelites are the only people on the face of the earth who don't know who they are. Ask around and you get a million answers: black, colored, African-American, Nuwabian, the Asiatic black man, Muslim, Christian, we are all one in Christ. Ask a white man and he says Polish; others can trace their lineage back to the village they come from and go back for a festival every year, while our family reunion is drinking and eating chicken.

“My people doth not consider.” Not only do we not know who we are, we don't even consider that we could be the people of this book. Israel has taught it for forty years, and our people are rebellious; now there are urban apologists whose whole life is set around proving Israel wrong. We are the only people who will fight not to be God's chosen.

On The Bachelor every woman lines up to marry the groom. Christ is the groom and Israel is the bride, and every nation would run to be the bride and have the promises and the covenant. Black people are the only ones on the show saying, don't nobody want him. Tell a black or Hispanic man he is above all people, blessed, stronger and wiser than all the nations, and he gets angry and throws stones at you. Who wins the billion-dollar lotto ticket and donates it to everybody else?

precepts.why:
The prophet is not sent “to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand.” He is not sent to people nobody can understand, not to Jackie Chan. “Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.”

That is how we know we are the people: any other nation would have hearkened, and Israel will not. Israel has the best videos, the best music, the best teachers; the Bishop and the Deacon broke it down for eight to ten hours, and no pastor in the history of Christianity ever touched any of that; the Bishop went through the book of Revelation from first to last with precise execution, precept upon precept. And still our people say, Nah, I'm good, I know he broke down Revelation, but what about John 3:16, what about Galatians 3:28. That is Israel not considering, exactly as Isaiah wrote. Every other nation would have hearkened in a heartbeat.

sense.text:
“My people.” All the prophets say the same thing: they are not talking to all people. That did not change when Paul was on the scene. When he says all, he is talking about all of the nation of Israel; when it says world, it is the world of Israel. The whole first half of the book has one target audience, and it does not change in the New. Chick-fil-A does not turn into a burger joint overnight.

“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me.” We have rejected knowledge, and the knowledge is the law of God.

Then: “seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.” That is what has happened to us. It is our people at the bottom of society: the black woman with her kids coming in every two seconds at tax time, living all year for a tax return, the drug dealer outside, the ball players and the rappers. Esau has us in a trick bag; this is all the matrix. Meanwhile the man down the street is teaching the law that will disrupt all of it, and when everybody is in line with that law, this world as you know it is finished. Everything revolves around Israel.

precepts.why:
What is the knowledge we rejected? “For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth.” The knowledge is the law. It is not what you learn at a university; the black woman is the most educated woman on the earth. The knowledge our people are ignorant of is the laws of God.

Our people don't understand that the Sabbath is the Lord's day, when you are not supposed to buy and sell, cook, or play football, because the white man says every day is the Sabbath. Our women don't know they are not supposed to wear pants, and our men in America don't know they are not supposed to shave their beards, because the white man said the opposite. That is the knowledge that was taken from us.

We are in a diabolical matrix, deeper than any movie can show: everything taught as good in America is bad. The delicacy you buy your wife is lobster, the scum of the earth; you pay two hundred dollars for a fat roach, you eat clam chowder, you upscale a burger with bacon. All of these things are abominable to God, and he looks at us like, Boy, y'all shoo.

We are living in the upside-down. “Ye are they which justify yourselves before men.” There are brothers and sisters who know the truth: they know what Israel is saying is right, they realize Jesus is black, but they won't come out of the pagan holidays and they won't keep any of the commandments.

“But God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.” Everything Esau and the nations put up high is an abomination to God. You are literally eating the rodents of the sea, the bottom feeder, and calling it a delicacy. It is like taking an undrafted free agent who can't even play and paying him more than LeBron. That is the knowledge turned upside down.

sense.text:
This is who we are in God's eye, though you have been taught we are all the same, one people, which they don't even believe. “For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.”

That is why we are different from everybody else. When we walk, talk and dance, it is the trend for the whole world; the salt of the earth comes from us. Take black and Hispanics off the earth and your entertainment will be Steve Irwin tackling an alligator. The man who flies through the air and spins, the man who dances backwards like he is levitating, the AC, the refrigerator, the cell phone: all of it comes from our people, because we are in tune with the Most High and he gave us these things. Nobody is like us.

The way we know we are the Israelites is the curses written in Deuteronomy 28. This is how you prove you are the true Jew, and nobody else can lay claim to it. “But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.”

If the children of Israel did not obey the laws of God, he would place curses on us. So the way you find out who you are is not ancestry.com, not 23andMe, not Ask Jeeves. You line up the curses and ask: did my forefathers and foremothers go through these things? If they did, you are an Israelite. It's that simple.

precepts.why:
The curses prove it: “And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships.” Egypt means bondage, slavery. We are the only people who went through the slave ships for five hundred years, with our identity, history, language, culture, diet and clothing all taken. Every people had some form of slavery, but nobody went through chattel slavery with no end, not seven years and out, but a whole nation taken. The Irish did not have their history taken; the Germans did not.

“By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen.” When we got off the slave ships we were sold to our enemies: the transatlantic slave trade, the Arab slave trade, the Indian Ocean slave trade, the triangle trade. The slave ships were real, packed tight or loose with our people as cargo. The immigrants came over with clothes on their backs and the things they brought from their land, and established businesses, and they are the ones lending to us today. So they are clearly not the people.

“and no man shall buy you” means nobody would redeem you. The urban apologists say it means Israel would offer themselves as slaves and nobody would buy them. Then show the history where the so-called white man offered himself as a slave and nobody bought him; you can't, so your understanding is wrong and those are not the people. The same verse says you will be sold. These Christians are dumb as hell, hell-bent on proving us wrong, and they ignore all that history to twist the scriptures.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other.” We went from the west coast of Africa all over the world.

“and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known.” Once we got to these lands we served other gods. The white Jesus is one: Jesus never looked like that, yet he is up in your house and in your church, and our fathers never knew a white Jesus. That is worshiping another god.

“even wood and stone.” Wood is the crucifix, Christianity; stone is the cobblestone, Islam. Those are the two primary religions the children of Israel are caught up in in these last days. If they can't get you with Christianity, you can be hardcore and a killer and be a Muslim. The Arabs were some of the most brutal slave owners, violent and wild, and those who emulate them are wild.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things.” We had to go to our oppressors for everything. We got off the slave ships naked, and there was no Dollar General in the slave quarters. It is the same today: your water, your heat, your car, your education, your birth and death certificates, your licensing, you have to go to your oppressor for all of it.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.” Show the so-called Jewish man, the Ashkenazi, with a yoke of iron on his neck. Search for Jews with yokes of iron on their necks and you will not find them; you find black people. That is how Israel is identified: through the scriptures, not through DNA. And now that this truth is shown, they call it racial idolatry.

sense.text:
The first thing Trump did when he got in office was take away DEI, by executive order on day one, and the companies followed: Walmart, Meta, Amazon, even McDonald's. It is not just Trump; the people in power are only the face, and they do what the collective wants. They said black people were getting too powerful, and it was time to lay them down. Yet a few months later black people are saying color doesn't matter. If it didn't matter, why could he run on it?

“Never trust thine enemy.” It sounds harsh, but it is in the Bible: the Christians say love your enemy, and the Bible says never trust him. This man hates you, and he has shown it over and over: the same man who sent the National Guard so you couldn't go to school with him, who bombed little girls in a church, who bombed the all-black Wall Street. And you think he loves you now?

“for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” We had DEI and the Civil Rights Act since 1964 and thought we were good, and he took it back. His wickedness comes back out, the way rust comes back on iron.

A black man in a suit and tie on national television, speaking of deportations and closed borders, said of the white man, Daddy's back. The black man is in love with his oppressor, and that is why we can't win our people over. The white race as a collective is the real Diddy. How is a black woman going to respect a man after that?

“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us.” That is what was just seen.

“for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves.” Just because he has a little higher position in captivity than his brothers, he makes these lies his refuge and thinks the scourge will not come to him.

When TikTok came back and the credit was given to Trump, our people played Dear Mama, a song near and dear to our hearts, to commemorate Donald Trump. It shows how near and dear the white man is to their heart. They are happy that he will let them carry on in debauchery.

“But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him”: get rid of the black Messiah, the righteous man. “Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King?”

“The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.” That is the black bourgeoisie, and that is the Daddy in the scriptures: Daddy's home.
